name: rotid-phase1-callsetup
purpose: Phase 1: call setup with test_rotating_ids on (call by the RDI the caller saw) versus off (call by the prefix); ASUS calls M31, 3 calls each.

rotating_on.notes: call by the RDI the caller saw in adv_address_seen version=5 (<id> each time: same RDI across 4 relaunches in the epoch)

results.note: Caller clock only (control applied -> call phase ACTIVE). Both phones need test_rotating_ids to see each other: with the switch only on M31, ASUS accepted 0 of 136 raw scan results (scan_stats raw=136 accepted=0). Discovery latency (launch to first offer) was not saved for these six runs.

method: Manual measurement session (not a runner suite, no generated media input). Address and identifier values, raw logs and controller captures are not published; counts and timings are.
